description: Resume a paused or stopped recurring-payment rule. Takes a ruleId (from q402_recurring_list). Supported transitions: paused → active, paused-by-archive → active (after restoring the wallet), and fired-cap-exceeded → active (after raising the per-tx cap or re-subscribing). nextRunAt is advanced to the next valid slot so the rule doesn't immediately fire on a stale schedule. Cancelled rules cannot be resumed - re-author via q402_recurring_create. Authenticated by the paid Multichain API key.

walletId.description: Optional. Lowercased Agent Wallet address when the user holds multiple wallets. Defaults to Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS env, then the owner's default wallet on the server.

name: q402_recurring_resume
